1b1(rgyud): @##//rgya gar skad du/sarba d+harma ma hA san ti bo d+hi tsid ta ku la ya ra dza/bod skad du/chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems kun bde rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bshad pa'i dus na/'og min gyi gnas chos nyid kyi mkha' 
2a1(rgyud): @##//dbyings nyid kyi klong sems nyid kyi gnas ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i gzhal yas khang na 
2a2(rgyud): nyid kyi rang bzhin dang /nyid kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje ye shes mngon du phyung ba'i 'khor 'di lta ste/nyid 
2a3(rgyud): kyi rang bzhin gyi 'khor chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sa zhes 
2a4(rgyud): bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid gyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rjogs pa'i sku chu zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /
2a5(rgyud): nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs
2a6(rgyud): longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku me zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longasaspyod rdzogs pa'i sku rlung zhes bya 
2b1(rgyud): ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /gzhan yang thugs rje ye shes 
2b2(rgyud): mngon du phyung ba'i sprul pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/'dod pa'i khams kyi sems can zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /gzugs kyi khams kyi 
2b3(rgyud): sems can zhes bya ba'i 'khod dang /gzugs med pa'i khams kyi sems cad zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang gzhan yang nyid kyi rang 
2b4(rgyud): bzhin la lta ba'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi 'di lta ste/shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang yongs su rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 
2b5(rgyud): 'khor dang /rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khaur dang /nyid kyi rang bzhin 
2b6(rgyud): dang /nyid kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje rang bzhin 'byed pa mi mnga' bas thabs gcig go/gzhan yang nyid kyi rang bzhin 
3a1(rgyud): @##//rtogs pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la gnas pa'i 'khor dang /da ltar bzhugs 
3a2(rgyud): pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis don mdzad pa'i 'khor dang /slad nas byon pa'i sangs rgyas nyid las 'byung ba'i 'khor dang /'byed pa mi 
3a3(rgyud): mnga' ba'i rang bzhin gyis thabs gcig par bzhugs so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des 'khor thams cad nyid kyi 
3a4(rgyud): rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir 'khor thams cad nyid kyis sems nyid kyi thugs la thim par mdzad do//rang 'byung gi ye 
3a5(rgyud): shes gsal bar mdzad do//de nas thams cad chos nyid du ldan par bya ba'i phyir thams cad bsdus nas thig le chen po gcig tu 
3a6(rgyud): bzhugs so//de nas sems dpa' de nyid kyi rang bzhin thig le chen po gcig tu bzhugs pa de las byung nas byang chub kyi sems 
3b1(rgyud): kun byed rgyal po'i spyan sngar dga' ba'i sems kyis dang ba'i mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos sems dpa' rdo rje la smras pa/sems dpa' rdo rje e ma ho//dga' ba'i sems skyes e ma ho//dang ba'i mdangs phyung e ma ho/nga las byung ba e ma ho zhes gsungs pas/de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//ston pa nyid kyang thig le spros med dam//'khor rnams kun kyang thig le spros med dam|/bstan pa kun kyang thig le spros med//dus dang gnas kyang thig le spros med dam //thams cad kun kyang thig le'i rang bzhin na//ston pa'i ston pas ci zhig ston par mdzad 'khor du 'khor ba'i don ci la 'khor//'khor la bstan pa ci zhig ston par byed//dus dang gnas ni gcig pa ji lta bu zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun 'byed rgyal po des sems dpa' rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po yid sgra la chug cig/ngas don sgrar bshad kyis/kye sems dpa' chen po//sems nyid kun byed rgyal po nyid ni//chos rnams thams cad kun gyi snying po ste//snying po ma spros ye nas thig le yin//thig le ye nas 
4a1(rgyud): @##//spros pa med pa'i don//ston pa dang ni bstan pa 'khor dus gnas//nga las byung bas ye nas thig le ste//nga yi rang bzhin thig le bstan pa yin zhes 
4a2(rgyud): gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed/rgyal po nges chos thams cad 
4a3(rgyud): nyid las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba la gnas par mdzad do//de nas 'khor gyi rang bzhin las sems dpa' rdo rje langs nas ston pa byang chub kyi sems kun 
4a4(rgyud): byed rgyal po'i zhal du mdangs phyung ste 'khod nas zhus pa/kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//khyod kyi 'khor du bdag 'dus 'khod pa de//bdag ni 'tshal 
4a5(rgyud): ba'i don ci zhig mchis//bdag 'tshal don ni khyod kyis bstan du gsol zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi semasakun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin dang /nyid 
4a6(rgyud): kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje las chos thams cad bkod pa ni nyid kyi rang 'byung gi ye shes chen po gcig las rang 'byung gi ye shes che po lnga phyung ba ni 'di 
4a7(rgyud): lta ste/zhe sdang rang 'byung ye shes chen po dang /'dod chags rang 'byung ye shes chen pa dang /gti mug rang 'byung ye shes chen mo dang /phrag dog rang 'byung 
4b1(rgyud): ye shes chen po dang /nga rgyal rang 'byung ye shes chen po dang /rang 'byung gi ye shes lnga po des rgyan gyi rgya chen po lnga ni phyung /'jig ci rab rten pa'i khams chen po gsum ni bkod rgyan 
4b2(rgyud): kyi rgyu'i lus lnga gcig tu blangs pa 'di lta ste/rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus sa zhes bya ba'i lus dang /rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus chu zhes bya ba'i lus dang /rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus me zhes bya ba'i lus dang /
4b3(rgyud): rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus rlung zhes bya ba'i lus dang //rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i lus la gcig tu lus thams cad blangs/ye shes lnga'i rigs so sor phye ste/rang 'byung ye shes 
4b4(rgyud): zhe sdang gi rigs dang /rang 'byung ye shes 'dod chags kyi rigs dang /rang 'byung yi shes gti mug gi rigs dang /rang 'byug ye shes phrag dog gi rigs dang /rang byung 
4b5(rgyud): ye shes nga rgyal gyi rigs dang /rang 'byung shes lnga'i rigs lus rgyan gyi lus can gyi chos nyid bkod do//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po de nyid kyang nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi 
4b6(rgyud): chos nyid bkod pa de bzhin du bzhugs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rje de byang chub kyi sems kun byed/rgyal po'i spyan sngar yang 'dug nas/kye ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/nyid kyi 
4b7(rgyud): thugs gcig rang 'byung ye shes las//rang 'byung ye shes rnam pa lnga byung nas//de las rgyan gyi rgyu lnga byung nas ni//ye shes lnga yis lus lnga blangs ba 'dis//kun byed 
5a1(rgyud): @#//rgyal po'i dgos pa ci zhes che zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des slar gsungs pa/kye sems dpa' chen po dgos pa ni/kun byed rgyal 
5a2(rgyud): po byed mkhan rabs ni//ma gtogs pa yi byed mkhan gzhan na med//chos nyid byed pa yang ni nga las med//ston pa gsum yang 'god pa nga las med//'khor gyi tshogs 
5a3(rgyud): yang 'god pa nga las med//de bzhin chos nyid 'god pa nga las med/sems dpa' rdo rje khyod la nga yis ni//nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan par bya//nga la rang bzhin rnam pa gsum 
5a4(rgyud): yod de//nga yi rang bzhin byang chub sems yin no//byang ba dag gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni//phun sum tshogs pa rnam gsum chos nyid byang //chub pa dag gi rang bzhin bstan ba ni//
5a5(rgyud): dgos pa tshogs pa rnam pa gsum gyis ni//nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab par gnas//sems shis bya ba'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni//mi 'gag ma lus kun byed rgyal po 
5a6(rgyud): ste//kun byas byang chub sems su ma lus byas shes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos nyid mngon du phyung nas bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o////
5a7(rgyud): de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed/rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi sngon rol tu byed pa po dbyung ba 'di gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po yid rna ba dbang la zhugs cig 
5b1(rgyud): sna dbang sgra la rtogs shig/kye nga ni kun byed rgyal po ste//nga ni kun byed byang chub sems//nga med pa yi sngon rol na//chos rnams 'byung ba'i snying po med//
5b2(rgyud): nga med pa yi sngon rol na//chos kun byed pa'i rgyal po med//nga med pa yi sngon rolan//ston pa bya ba la nas med//nga med pa yi sngo rol na//bstan pa bya ba ye na med//nga med pa yi sngo
5b3(rgyud): rol nas//'khor zhes bya ba ye nas med//sems dpa' rdo rje rtog ma ste//sems dpa' chen po khyod nyid kyang //nga yi ngo bo sprul pa yin zhes gsungs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes 
5b4(rgyud): byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po la zhus pa/kye kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems//khyod ni ye nas chen po yin//ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang //'khor la sogs pa'i chos rnams kun//
5b5(rgyud): byed mkhan khyod kyis byas pas na//ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun//byed mkhan khyod kyis byas bar snang //stan pa gcig gi rnam da du ru yod//bstan pa gcig gam rnam pa du ru yod//
5b6(rgyud): 'khor rnams gcig gam rnam pa du ru yid ces zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun bye da rgyal pos slar gsungs pa/kye rang 'byung ye shes kun gyi ston par gcig/nga yi rang bzhin 
5b7(rgyud): rnam gsum snang ba la//ston pa'i grangs ni rnam pa gsum du byung //nga ni de bzhin nyid du gcig pa las//chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid//nga nyid byang chub sems las 
6a1(rgyud): @#//gzhan med do//nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis//'khor la bstan pa rnam pa gsum du bstan//nga yi ngo bo gcig tu phyung nas ni//nga yi rang bzhin cig tu 
6a2(rgyud): bstan pa'i phyir//kun byed nga yi 'khor du kun kyang gcig/nga las byung ba'i ston ba sku gsum gyis//'khor gyi bye brag rnam pa gsum du yod ces gsungs so//sems dpa' rdo rjes 
6a3(rgyud): zhus pa/kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/khyod las byung ba'i ston pa sku bsum gyis//khyod sar 'gro ba'i lam ni yod ngam med//med na khyod kyis sa ru phyin mi phyin/
6a4(rgyud): yod na bgrod nas phyin nas ma bgrod phyin//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig/nga las byung ba'i stong pa sku gsum la/nga yi sa ru bgrod pa'i lam med de//nga yi rang byung ye shes bstan 
6a5(rgyud): pa yin//sku gsum ston pa de yi 'khor rnams la//rnam par thar pa'i lam ni rnam lnga ste//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lam du bstan//rang 'byung ye shes lnga yi lam lnga ni//
6a6(rgyud): 'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang gti mug dang //nga rgyal dang ni phag dog rnam lnga ste//rang 'byung ye shes rnam lnga kun gyi lam zhes gsungs//ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyul bo lags//
6a7(rgyud): rang 'byung ye shes lam lnga bstan pa de//rang 'byung zhes ni ji ltar byung ba lags//ye shes bya ba'i gtan tshigs ci la gdags//lam zhes bgyi ba'i don ni gang la bgyi//'dod 
6b1(rgyud): chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang //phrag dog la sogs rnam pa lnga po de//lam lnga yin pa'i don ni bshad du gsal zhes zhus so//kye sems dpa' chen po/rang 'byung ye shes 
6b2(rgyud): rnam pa lnga lam ni//rang 'byung rgya rkyen med par byung ba yin//ye shes 'gag pa med par gsal pa yin/lam ni rgyu rkyen med pas bgrod mi dgos//mi bgrod rang 'byung lnga la lam 
6b3(rgyud): lngar bshad//'dod pa chos rnams bdag tu 'dod pa yin//chags pa bdag tu 'dod pa de la chags//zhi ba skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la//sdang ba cho 'phrul sna tshogs de la sdang //
6b4(rgyud): gti mug mi rtog pa yi ting 'dzin gyis//chos nyid mnyam pa nyid la dbye gsal med//nga ni ma nor ba yi byang chub sems//de bzhin nyid du ye nas rgyal bar byed//thams cad de 
6b5(rgyud): bzhin nyid du gcig pa la//yin chen sgro skur 'debs pa phrag dog byed//bgrod du med pa'i lam lnga bstan pa yin/kye sems dpa' chen po nyan cig/ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad 
6b6(rgyud): kun//rang 'byung ye shes lam lnga 'di las byung //'dod pa'i khams kyang rang 'byung ye shes yin//gzugs kyi khams kyang rang 'byung ye shas yin//gzugs med khams kyang rang 
6b7(rgyud): 'byung ye shes yin//kun byed rgyal po nga yis byas pa'i phyir//ngas byas thams cad ye shes ngo bor bshad//khams gsum sems can rgyu drug thams cad kun//rang 'byung 
7a1(rgyud): @#//ye shes med par ngas ma bshad//de las ma gtogs pa yi byang chub sems//sangs rgyas kun gyi mes phongs ma bshad//kun byed rgyal po nga yi 
7a2(rgyud): rang bzhin la//chos nyid rnam pa gsum du bstan pa ste//ma skyes pa yi chos nyid dngos mi snang //de ni gzugs med khams su bstan pa yin//skye ba'i cho 'phrul gzugs su snang 
7a3(rgyud): ba ni//de ni gzugs kyi khams su bstan pa yin//thugs rje ye shes ngo bo sngon phyung nas//bde sdug las de thugs rjes zad bya'i phyir//'dod pa'i khams ni thugs rjes phyung 
7a4(rgyud): ba yin zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos thams cad kun byed rgyal pos byas pa las ji ltar byung ba'i khungs bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o////
7a5(rgyud): de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed//des nyid kyi rang bzhin mtshan gyi chos bshad pa 'di gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod nyon cig/nga ni ye nas rang 'byung ye shes 
7a6(rgyud): te//nga ni ye nas chos kun snang po yin//nga ni kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems//nga las mtshan 'di sems dpa' rtogs par gyis//nga yi mtshan 'di sems dpas rtogs 
7a7(rgyud): 'gyur na/chos rnams thams cad ma lus rtogs 'gyur gyis//nga zhes bya ba'i snang po ste//chos rnams kun gyi snying po yin//rang 'byung zhi ni bya ba ni//rgyu rkyen med pa'i 
7b1(rgyud): snying po pas//rtsol sgrub kun las 'das pa yin//ye shes zhes ni bya ba ni//'gag pa med cing ma bsgribs pas//chos kun ma lus ston par byed//nga ni byang chub sems la bya//
7b2(rgyud): ye nas bya ba'i don 'di ni//thog ma nyid nas gnas pa'i don//chos kun zhes ni bya ba ni//ston pa kun kyang chos nyid la//bstan pa kun kyang chos nyid yin//'khor gnas dus kyang 
7b3(rgyud): chos nyid de//chos nyid ma yin gcig kyang med//snying po bya ba'i don 'di ni//thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po ste//byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las//ston pa kun yang de las byung 
7b4(rgyud): bstan pa gsum yang de las byung //'khor gnas dus kyang de las byung //thams cad 'byung ba'i snang por bshad//nga ni snying po sems nyid kyis//chos rnams ma lus kun 
7b5(rgyud): byed de//kun zhes bya ba'i chos rnams kun//chos kun gang dang gang zhe na//ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang //'khor gnas dus ni thams cad kun//byed ces bya ba mkhan po ste//ston 
7b6(rgyud): pa dang ni bstan pa dang //'khor gnas dus ni kun byed pas//rang 'byung ye shes mkhan po yin//rgyal po zhes ni bya ba ni//snying po rang 'byung ye shes de//byed pa'i mkhan po 
7b7(rgyud): kun las rgyal//chos rnams byed mkhan kun las rgyal//byang ba'i don ni 'di lta ste//snying po byang chub sems de ni//rang 'byung ye nas rnam dag pas//kun byed 
8a1(rgyud): rgyal pos byas pa kun//kun bzang nyid du rnam dag pas//byang zhes bya bar bshad pa yin//chub ces bya ba 'di lta ste//snying po rang 'byung ye shes des//
8a2(rgyud): pa dang ni srid pa dang //snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pa dang //dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang //khams gsum rgyud drug sems can dang //de bzhin nyid ni thams cad 
8a3(rgyud): la//kun la chub ste khyab par gnas//des na chub ces bya bar bshad//sems kyi don ni 'di lta ste//snying po ranga'abyung ye shes des//snang srid sdod bcud thams cad la//
8a4(rgyud): 'jug cing dbang sgyur gsal bar gcod//des na sems zhes bya bar bshad//rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po des//kun la dbang sgyur thams cad byed//kye sems dpa' chen po//
8a5(rgyud): nga mi rang bzhin rtogs gyur na//ston pa kun kyang rtogs 'gyur la//bstan pa kun kyang rtogs par 'gyur//'khor gyi bsam pa rig 'gyur la//dus gnas kun kyang gcig 
8a6(rgyud): 'gyur rig/chos rnams thams cad nga yin pas//nga yi rang bzhin 'di rig na//chos rnams thams cad rig 'gyur bas//bya byed rtsol sgrub kun las 'das//mi rtsol 
8a7(rgyud): lhun gyis grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las nyid kyi mtshan bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems 
8b1(rgyud): kun byed rgyal pos sems dpa' rdo rje nyid la rang bzhin bstan pa'i mdo 'dus pa'i don 'di bstan to//sems dpa' chen po nyon cig/nga yi rang bzhin 'di lta ste//yod ni gcig 
8b2(rgyud): las med pa ste//bstan ni rnam pa gnyis su bstan//byung ni theg pa dgu ru byung //'dus ni rdzogs pa chen por 'dus//yin ni byang chub sems yin te//gnas ni chos nyid dbyings 
8b3(rgyud): la gnas//gsal ni rigs pa mkha' la gsal//khyab ni snod bcud kun la khyab//byung ni snang srid kun tu byung //bstan du mtshan ma'i dngos po med//mthong du dmigs pa'i 
8b4(rgyud): yul dang bral//shes su tshig tu brjod du med//rgyu las ma byung sa po 'di//sgros kyis btags pa kun dang bral//don 'di nges par rtogs 'dod na//dpe ni nam mkha' lta bur 
8b5(rgyud): brtag/don ni chos nyid skye ba med//rtags ni sems nyid 'gag pa med//nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid la//nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon//dmigs su med pa'i chos nyid la//
8b6(rgyud): dmigs su med par mtshon te bstan//tshig tu brjod du med pa la//brjod du med pa'i tshig brjod de//dmigs med don gyi ngo bor bstan//bsdus te bstan pa'i don 'di ni//don 
8b7(rgyud): gyi ngo bo 'grel pa ste//'di yis nga don rtogs par gyis//'di yis nga don rtog par byed//'di yis nga don ma rtogs na//don gyi sgra tshig ci bstan kyang //nga dang phrad par mi 'gyur 
9a1(rgyud): @#//'byung te//nga las gol la nga bsgribs pas//chos kyi snying po mthong mi 'gyur zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po kha rgya don gyi 'grel pa'i 
9a2(rgyud): le'u ste lnga pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed/rgyal po des chos thams cad nyid kyi rang bzhin la rdzogs pa de bstan pa'i tshig gsungs so//kye sems dpa' 
9a3(rgyud): chen po 'di nyon//kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni//nga yi chos rnams dang por bkod//nga yi chos rnams mngon du phyung //nga yi ngo bo khyod la bstan//nga yi rang bzhin bstan nas ni//tshig 
9a4(rgyud): dang sgras kyang don mtshon nas//ngo bo bstan pas khyod kyis mthong //rang bzhin bstan pas a de rig/tshig tu brjod pas dong sgrar thos//shes gsungs nas cang mi gsung 
9a5(rgyud): bar chos thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs so//sems dpa' rdo rje 'khor gyi nang na langs pa byang chub kyi sems kun byang rgyal po'i zhabs mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas kun byed rgyal 
9a6(rgyud): pos/kye sems dpa' chen po khyod nga la mdangs kyis 'khod pa de khyod kyis don ci 'dod pa gsol cig ces gsungs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/kye ston pa'i 
9a7(rgyud): ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//chos rnams thams cad khyod kyi rang bzhin na//khyod kyis ston pa bstan pa 'khor ba shong ci zhig lags//phun sum tshogs pa'i dgos pa 
9b1(rgyud): ci zhig lags zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig chos rnams phun sum 
9b2(rgyud): tshogs par bkod pa ni//nga nyid phun tshogs pa'i rang bzhin te//nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan par bya//nga yi rang bzhin spros bral mi phyed pa la//chos dbyings gnas
